what: Outbound Trust Engine target list — real, shipped, AI-built products with a public URL.

policy.sendingIsHuman: No script in this repository sends anything. scan_to_teaser.mjs writes markdown to a file. A teaser reaches a person only when Ty sends it himself.
policy.approvalGate: A target may be contacted only when approved === true and approvedBy names the human who approved it. The first ten approvals are Ty's, one at a time.
policy.scanBoundary: Targets are read at their public surface only: GET the page, GET the same-origin assets the page declares. No login, no probing, no fuzzing, no path guessing. See the rails at the top of scan_to_teaser.mjs.
policy.builderAttribution: Every row's `builder` is a phrase the repo says about itself, matched by the recorded query. It is not verified. Confirm it before a teaser repeats it back to the owner — being told what built your product, wrongly, is a worse first impression than saying nothing.
policy.contactSourcing: contact is filled by a human from a channel the person published for this purpose. No address scraping, no pattern-guessed addresses, no third-party enrichment vendor.
policy.sendPosture: Warmed fire-os domain, inside its per-day sending limit, one-to-one, plain text, with a working unsubscribe intent honoured on the first request. Ty confirms the domain and the daily cap before the first send.
policy.redaction: Teasers carry redacted evidence only. Unredacted values go to the product's own owner, at an address they nominate, on request.
